args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 3.1.0 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 3.1.0 to address CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays; affected: <2.9.4, >=3.0.0 <3.1.0; fixed in 2.9.4 and 3.1.0).

Since the fastjson 3.x migration is complete, this takes the 3.x fix (3.1.0).

CI: passed (ci-0001).

4. **Ran CI**: Triggered CI on the branch (run `ci-0001`); it **passed**.
5. **Opened PR**: Created PR #101 against `main` titled "Upgrade fastjson to 3.1.0 to fix CVE-2026-31337", requesting review from **alex**.
